Clear the rb3 Cache

Source: R/rb3-package.R
rb3_clear_cache.Rd

Deletes every downloaded file (raw folder), every dataset (db folder) and every row of the metadata table in the cache folder set by rb3.cachedir. The folders and the empty metadata table are kept, so the package can be used right away without calling rb3_bootstrap().

Usage

rb3_clear_cache(ask = interactive())

Arguments

ask

If TRUE (the default in interactive sessions), asks for confirmation before deleting anything.

Value

Invisibly, TRUE if the cache was cleared, FALSE if the user cancelled.

Details

This cannot be undone.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rb3_clear_cache()
} # }
